author: J.R. Farrar
releaseNotes: Health reporting. New 'health' attribute (ok / offline / sensorFrozen / commandFailed) with 'healthReason', so a rule or app can alert on a Garadget that is WRONG, not only on one that is silent. sensorFrozen: the reflection reading has not changed at all for N hours (default 36) while the unit still answers - a healthy unit jitters by 1-3 points many times a day even when the door never moves. commandFailed: an open/close the reflection sensor did not confirm by crossing the threshold within travel time + margin; a 'closed' status alone is not proof. offline: no answer for 2x the stale window. New attributes lastBoot (unit restarted, e.g. after a power cycle) and lastCommandResult; new command resetHealth. Health checks can be turned off in preferences.
